fact: The 2025-2029 strategic plan states the national civil status file is not yet complete and that civil registration interoperability with DGSN (ID card, passports), Justice, ELECAM, Finance, CNPS and the tax number remains low, with a unique personal ID (NIPU) to be implemented by 2029.
title: Strategic Plan for the Modernization of the Civil Registration and Vital Statistics System 2025-2029
